name: Good Intentions
source:
he comes barging in, trying his best to sweep her off her feet. She's content with her life and isn't about to lose her footing. How can he persist, when she keeps resisting?

(https://www.vienna-hale.com/episode-interactive)
translation:
他横冲直撞地闯进她的生活，使出浑身解数想要俘获她的芳心；可安于现状的她却稳稳站定脚跟，半点不打算轻易沦陷。面对她的再三抗拒，他究竟该如何坚持到底？

[摘自https://www.vienna-hale.com/episode-interactive]
